user.title: Create an energy sum group
user.description: Creates a sensor that adds up the consumption of the selected energy meters. Unlike a regular sum group, it never drops when a meter goes offline or its counter restarts, so it doesn't create spikes in the Energy dashboard. It starts at 0 and counts up from there.

error.need_one_member: Select at least one energy meter.

init.title: Edit energy sum group
init.description: Meters you add start counting from their current value; meters you remove keep what they already contributed.
